probe: plan-52.3 dividendmax public-page capture (pivot from paid API: no key available)

access.mode: public HTML pages + one public JSON endpoint — NO API key required
access.resolution_endpoint: GET /suggest.json?q={query} (unauthenticated JSON: [{search, id, name, ticker, flag, image, path}])
resolution_caveats: partial name matches included — filter results to ticker == query (case-insensitive)
same ticker can map to multiple listings (VOD: UK plc + US ADR) — disambiguate by preferring the US listing for bare tickers (openst universe is US + GPW .WA)
access.site_protection: Cloudflare (some routes 403 on direct hits) + reCAPTCHA v3 on home/interactive; the two scrape targets (suggest.json, /dividends pages) answered 200 with a plain Mozilla UA

tos: terms_and_conditions: content may be used for personal non-commercial use with notices intact; may NOT be reproduced/modified/copied/distributed or used commercially. Personal-use, low-volume scraping (2 polite requests per symbol, long Redis cache) — user decision 2026-09-24.

history_table.selector: table[aria-label='Declared and forecast {NAME} dividends'] (class mdc-data-table__table; second table on page; first table's aria-label is None, third = annual totals)
history_table.pagination: none — full history (roughly last 20 years of Paid rows) + ~5 forecast years in one page
history_table.dates: DD Mon YYYY (English month names, e.g. '31 Oct 2030'); missing = '–' (en dash), not 'bd.'

amounts.notation: SUBUNIT: '265c' (AAPL, letter c), '4.5¢' (unicode cent, Vodafone USD rows), '7.77p' (pence, GBP rows) — divide by 100; 'Sign up' = forecast amount gated (never needed for Paid rows); '—' = None
amounts.use_column: Decl. amount for Paid rows; Forecast amount is 'Sign up' (gated) for Forecast rows

history_table.currency: per-row Decl. Currency (EUR/GBP/USD seen on Vodafone alone) — carries with the row
history_table.known_noise: early rows can be bogus (AAPL: 'Paid Final 31 Dec 2011 … 0c' predates Apple's real first dividend) — keep as-is, user handles data inconsistencies manually per house rule

fixtures.suggest-aapl.json: AAPL resolves to 1 exact ticker match (Apple Inc) + 1 name-only match (APLY) — proves ticker filter needed
fixtures.dividends-aapl.html: US payer, NASDAQ; 75 data rows (2011–2030), 49 Paid, USD, 'c' notation
fixtures.suggest-vodafone.json: VOD resolves to 2 exact ticker matches (UK plc + US ADR) — proves disambiguation needed
fixtures.dividends-vodafone.html: UK payer, LSE; 49 data rows (2006–2031), 39 Paid, EUR/GBP/USD mixed, '¢'/'p' notation

volume_estimate: 2 requests per symbol (suggest.json + one page) — negligible; politeness delay + long cache per house scraping convention (cf. biznesradar)
